performance.workload: metadata traversal across all eleven protected roots without reading file contents or mutating data

evidence: PR #681 head ce91d1ce108be22a761a1b743ab0b07fb6217658 passed all protected checks and merged as 70dcc972d7bd8ca9f382daf3e6a0a46516883ed2 without bypass.
All eleven exact post-merge main check runs completed SUCCESS on main@70dcc972.
A real host reboot changed boot_id from 0fcf97d2-08ca-48b9-b20f-1b5be4eeec0b to 436d6377-f8e3-4e90-b226-3ddc8acf7bc8 while the MCP tunnel returned independently of Docker.
Docker failed closed after boot because the asset mapper was unavailable; production services did not start against plaintext fallback.

The externally retained active-key bundle was materialized only to tmpfs with mode 0600, used by the reviewed guarded unlock path, and removed immediately after successful unlock; no raw key material is retained in this receipt.
The reviewed unlock returned vaults_unlocked_host_ready_docker_stopped for both vaults, after which Docker passed its ExecStartPre host gate.
A fresh post-boot FR-06B3A runtime snapshot and admission evaluation returned production_preflight_ready with zero blockers on main@70dcc972.
Post-reboot guarded-start succeeded on attempt one and retained candidate_started_admission_closed; application admission was not opened.

All 47 active protected mounts across 19 running service definitions resolve to the two mapper-backed encrypted volumes with exact read-only/read-write access; no running protected service uses a legacy plaintext volume.
All eleven legacy roots remain read-only for rollback and were not deleted.
Post-reboot p95 was 14.530 ms against a 13.984 ms baseline and 16.082 ms maximum, a 3.906 percent regression within the 15 percent gate.
Encrypted platform backup 7957b4e6-dbf4-48a8-a718-46daa01c890d completed locally and offsite with schema 2 and 250 protected asset files.
Independent restore validation 2e885dda-b79e-4a5a-8105-af2e2e5be65c completed with validated=true and offsite_validated=true for the database and protected asset snapshot.

A governed 3D project build executed npm ci, npm run build, browser QA and performance checks directly on the encrypted project-execution vault with release_ready=true and no paid provider generation; the canary was removed afterward.

Final runtime has 36 running containers and zero unhealthy healthchecked containers; local and public health/ready and the user portal return 200; no backup/restore job remains active and no recent critical/traceback/fatal/unhandled matches were found in the checked core worker logs.
Cloudflare was not changed and application admission remains closed by this encryption batch.
summary_ar: اكتملت FR-06B5 وFR-06B تشغيليًا بالدليل بعد قطع حي محكوم ثم إعادة تشغيل Docker ثم إعادة إقلاع حقيقية للمضيف. بعد الإقلاع فشل Docker مغلقًا كما صُمم لغياب الـmapper، وعاد MCP مستقلًا؛ استُعيد active bundle من الحفظ الخارجي إلى tmpfs فقط، نجح unlock المحكوم لخزنتين ثم أزيلت مادة الإدخال. أعيد تشغيل الخدمات المحمية حصريًا عبر guarded-start من المحاولة الأولى مع بقاء admission مغلقًا. طابقت 47 mount فعليًا الخزائن المشفرة، وبقيت الجذور القديمة الأحد عشر read-only للرجوع. اجتاز p95 حد 15%، ونجحت نسخة R2 مشفرة جديدة واستعادة مستقلة، ونجح governed build حقيقي على project-execution vault مع Browser QA والأداء والتنظيف. الصحة النهائية 36 حاوية عاملة وصفر unhealthy، وكل health/ready والبوابة العامة = 200. FR-06B مكتملة؛ FR-06 الأم تبقى مفتوحة لأن FR-06C لبيانات المحادثات وDB/WAL والسجلات وما تبقى من البيانات الحساسة لم تغلق بعد.
next_action_ar: ابدأ FR-06C بجرد حي read-only للـPostgreSQL PGDATA/WAL والسجلات والمؤقتات والأسرار والـswap وبقية البيانات الحساسة، ثم جزئ النقل على خزائن منفصلة وفق ADR-001. لا تنقل قاعدة البيانات أو runtime state حيًا قبل عقد consistency/recovery ونسخة R2 حديثة واختبار معزول وفحوص محمية وخطة rollback.
